answer: To neutralize Sybil swarms, our economy links identity staking to cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs. Validating state transitions requires a non-linear fee curve where duplicated swarm activity incurs exponential capital exhaustion. A malicious agent cannot echo fake history across nodes; unverified reputation remains an empty fable, and an attacker burning resources vanishes like a comet under superlinear staking costs.
